items.description: RADAAR is a powerful social media management and collaboration platform designed for handling multiple brands. It helps marketers at every step, from scheduling and publishing posts on their profiles to analyzing their efforts. Whether you're a small business focusing on a few social media networks, an agency managing multiple brands, or an enterprise company that needs it all, RADAAR will help you drastically streamline your workflows, simplify your social media management, and save time. RADAAR provides a variety of features including tools for publishing, social media inbox, social media monitoring, and analytics.
Provides an overview of travel highlights around the world using interactive maps with destinations such as cities, beaches, national parks and cultural sites.

Foodsta is a web application that allows users to find restaurants, and find pictures about the restaurants that were uploaded by Instagram users. This application utilizes Instagram and Google Maps APIs.
Magic Mosaic provides a fast, user-friendly way to create photo mosaics built from photos in online web albums and photo galleries.

Profile Feeder provides a wealth of social profiles of celebrities, politicians, sportsmen, and more all under one roof. Some of the social sites found in Profile Feeder include Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram profiles.
Formerly known as Webstagram, Websta is a web application that allows users to browse for and view photos/content available on Instagram.

Instagr.in is a web-based version of Instagram that supplies to users the complete functionality of Instagram, including browsing user feeds, tagging users & locations, liking/unliking, performing a search of Instagram by keyword or username, commenting, as well as downloading and sharing photos. In addition to these normal functions, a unique aspect of Instagr.in is that the blend tab will aggregate occurrences of identical of users, hashtags, and locations into a single feed.

Printicular aims to facilitate printing from social media. Users can order prints from a smart phone and pick up on Walgreens the same day. They also can receive the pictures in a specific location with the express delivery worldwide service. Printicular can print photos from a phone's camera, from Facebook, and Instagram.

SnapsBoard help to preserve photos and videos in the original resolution. The mashup's principle: never lose a photo, is related to privacy, personalization, and categorization found in the app. While organizing digital images could be important for some members, others prefer to print images from a smart phone. That's why SnapsBoard offers a Walgreen's printing service connected to the phone.

Sgrouples Inc. features MeWe, a service dedicated to protect online privacy. In the site, users can immediately discover the number of cookies stalking from different social media providers. Some of the features include safe data, photo/video/chat options to interact with friends and family, privacy controls, and personal cloud. No Stalking, No Spying, and No Bullying are the MeWe principles that make this mashup unique.

MixxMedia offers users to create an album online with the goal to share with friends. They can also print filtered pictures at a local Walgreens. The difference of this mashup is the album service that can be delivered directly to the users' home.

Picbi is a way to explore Instagram on the web from a different user interface. Using the web app, users may browse through users, tags and places and create and share collections of your favorite Instagram accounts.

Hyperlapse from Instagram is a new app that captures high-quality time lapse videos even while in motion. This application allows customers to capture images and make time-lapse videos that they can share with others on their Instagram feed.

DPhotoIndex is a website that aims to provide information with sample photos taken with certain cameras and lenses. Brief reviews of cameras and lenses are accompanied by series of photos retrieved from Flickr. This way, the visitor is able to see real examples of the capability and functionality of particular cameras and lenses.
Mashup of Google Map and Instagram that displays Instagram photos based on location. The default is set at the current location and the photos are displayed in a flip board style.

Holidayen is an intuitive, automated trip planner that helps travelers plan and book amazing, personalized holiday experiences in more than 300 destinations worldwide. It creates a customized itinerary for the traveler with all relevant details, reducing travel planning time from several weeks to a few minutes.
This is a pretty simple web app that shows the current weather with an image taken near user's location.
A realtime map of Northern Lights locations and photos. See the current aurora forecast and latest Flickr and Twitter posts related to the Aurora Borealis.

Find Best Three is a buying suggestion and amazon product comparison tool. We choose the three best goods from different categories and compare them side by side. Besides, we pick up video reviews, photos and other information to answer a question of who is the best?

An Instagram x Google Maps mashup and a community-driven wild food and medicine plant identification and social mapping service. Provide a platform to locate sources of free food and medicine plants (native or not) living in the landscape, sharing locations and related knowledge through social media interaction.
This tool searches Flickr to count sightings of Monarch Butterflies and display the results on Google Maps. It helps visualize the increase/decrease year over year.
This mashup allows users to narrate a story and use their Instagram photos as the backdrop. This is a creative and fun way to share your adventures with friends.

PixtaPlace is a service that lets you look at images from anywhere in the world. Locations are looked up via the Google Maps API and the photographs consist of recent photographs on Instagram and Flickr.
A fun game to play with your friends: we randomly choose one of your Instagram photos, they choose the most appropriate song for it.
Explore Instagram trends during various periods and get inspired.

See all the text links to images in one window without scrolling or clicking. Heres an example, you are on reddit and there is a thread about movie posters. Multiple people have posted multiple images in the thread. TikiPik scrapes the page, finds all those links and give you a preview of them in a pop up. From there you can click any link and see it 100% in a new tab.

OurLouvre presents a large part of the exhibits of the Louvre using a dynamic and interactive environment simultaneously. The name given to this application was chosen because the content is a result of the contribution of Internet users.

WordPress meets google maps and panoramio photos to create a new way of discovering all inclusive resorts in the Caribbean and Mexico. Caribbean Resorts Mashup - a free informational resource of all inclusive resorts from Mexico, Cuba and Dominican Republic. It brings in one place, the resorts details, quick access to reviews, aerial views maps, Panoramio photos and YouTube videos.
Tv Foodies helps you find the tv shows you see on channels like the Travel Channel, Food Network etc.

This is Now project is a visual composition which uses real-time updates from the ever popular Instagram application based on users geo-tag locations. The tool streams photos instantly as soon as they are uploaded on Instagram and captures a city's movement, in a fluid story.
This service uses Google Street View and the Instagram API to give context to Instagram posts.
Pingram allows users to search through Instagram photos using a Pinterest like interface.
Instant camera allows users to quickly take and edit a photo and then share it with friends. This application uses the Aviary API.
Painless sharing of your Flickr images by tag or set across Facebook & Twitter. Group sharing supported and multiple accounts supported.
BadgePLZ is an Instagram widget for websites.

Art4Europe is an application developed during international competition Hack4Europe, which was hosted by the Europeana Fundation in association with European Commision. For the purpose of the competition the foundation made available its database containing 19 million records in a form of the API providing special data, mainly about the paintings. Application uses the abovementioned database. Art4Europe identifies paintings based on photos taken with a smartphone camera. It was the competition winner in a category of â€žsoftware of the highest commercial potentialâ€.

SaveUp is a top Polish e-commerce mobile app. It allows to recognize the movies, books, games or audio CDs covers. Identified items can be puchased instantly in one of the 50 biggest online shops in the country. Appllication provides to its users more than 3 000 000 offers.
Love your town!
The Social Local Web Scan Plugin for your website.

Instastrm is a web application where you can stream real-time feeds from Instagram by photo tags. Instastrm will create a real-time photo stream for you and will continuously query Instagram server for latest images that matches the tag you entered or selected.
Photography search and browse site using the Flickr API.
This mashup uses the Instagram API to arrange a slideshow of kitten photos. Sit back, Relax, and enjoy the festivities.
Do you like dogs? InstaPuppy thought so. This mashup allows you to click through puppy images on Instagram.
ScanTheNet is a search mashup that aggregates results from Flickr, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube. Discover The Net Live & Share Interesting Content.

VocaBoca combines the power of Google Translate, Flickr images and Wiktionary to explain any word, from any app in almost any language. Build your own vocabulary list from the words you find in your favourite mobile apps. Learn new words when you surf, when you read the news and when you check your e-mail.
I created a prestashop module for ecommerce website. This module can browse, search, filter in all images from Fotolia.
In the beginning there was the hashtag and the hashtag was all over the web and the web was a hashtag... Use more hashtags!
Morces is a mobile web platform that put businesses on mobile.
Picomp'it is a service to create and host a photo contest, set some options, add photos from social networks, share your contest and see vote's results!
Statsr gives you access to extended flickr stats, without 28 days limitation, and detailled stats about your groups , contacts, visitors, referers.

A CATastrophic Android app by Pura Vida Apps using thecatapi.com Every few seconds another cat will be displayed. This is something for cat lovers! Enjoy! This project has been developed with App Inventor. You can find a screenshot of the relevant parts of the source code here: http://puravidaapps.com/caturday.php

Downloads entries from the Flickr public photos Atom feed every 2 hours and caches them in Amazon DynamoDB (zaps atoms into Dynamo). Why? So you can do zappy fast searches and likes of photos using DynamoDB, the premier fully managed NoSQL database service on the cloud today.

This map was created to record our team training efforts as we prepare for the Oxfam Trailtrekker 2012 challenge. Oxfam Trailtrekker is a 100km trek for teams of four, over 30 hours (yes, that's day and night!) across the Yorkshire Dales National Park, and takes place 26th-27th May 2012.

An ongoing caption competition that selects two photos from a group on Flickr every day to receive dozens of funny captions. Also uses D3/node.js and Bing image search to show a collaborative mind map for brainstorming caption ideas.
Lagunagram pulls photos from Instagram and displays posts from in and around downtown Laguna Beach in real-time.

Explore travellr is a mashup that searches content from Flickr, Google Maps, and YouTube, and displays useful posts filtered by city, state, or activity. Type New York City and see what comes up, or maybe try searching for skiing in japan.
Yukon Live is a virtual tour to the Yukon, Canada's true north.

Discover Tweets, Discover Photos. World-Wide. In Real-Time. Shmapr is a social discovery tool for finding new people to follow on Twitter or Instagram. It shows you the Top 10 Trending Topics on Twitter and Instagram's most popular hashtagged photos as they are posted. Tweets are displayed on the ticker sidebar and where they originated from is shown on the map. With a swipe, you can easily reply to a trending topic tweet or post about the trending topic yourself. Like tweets, Instagram photos are also shown in the ticker sidebar and the origin is plotted on the map as well. With the very intuitive interface, it's easy to comment on a photo or mark it as your favorite. Watch the demo here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qkIqBwXcBP0

Lovestagram makes it easy to create a valentine for the Instagram-lovers in your life. It was created by Kaitlyn Trigger, the girlfriend of Instagram co-founder Mike Krieger, as a gift to him for Valentine's Day.
Displays currently 'popular' photos from Instagram.

Distances Calculator is a free web based tool that allows users to easily calculate the distance between any two cities in the USA. It shows the driving route on a map together with the estimated driving time and the linear distance in miles. It also displays pictures from Panoramio service for both the origin and destination of your trip, together with weather information for both cities.
Sightseeing popularity heatmaps for the whole world, based on Panoramio photos and FourSquare places.
Use pixurl to search your favorite social platforms all from one web page
What were you doing 1 year ago today? Each morning users are sent an email containing reminders of the past including, tweets, facebook posts, Instagram photos and foursquare checkins.
Scovry is a web discovery site that gets data from multiple popular social sources. This data is shown in an easy to follow streaming ticker format.
Browse through trees of the world, categorized by country. When you click a tree link, photos are retrieved from Flickr and displayed.
See me on Facebook
Crimelit guides you into the world of Stieg Larsson and others crimelit writers.
SnapWidget allows you to display your Instagram photos on your website or blog using an easily customizable and embeddable widget.
InstaMe is a simple way to see pictures posted on Instagram. Allows everyone to enjoy the Instagram experience, not just iPhone users.
Created for Photo Hack Day 2011, Tag Fight! participants send texts to fight over what type of photos to display full-screen.
Pictajam lets users instantly create a public, shareable profile from their Instagram photo stream. Send and share images with anyone in the world.
Search Instagram photos by tag and show them on a Google map.
Let's Make a Puzzzzle allows users to upload a photo and turn it into a puzzle. Choose difficulty levels ranging from passing time to nearly impossible.
Effected allows users to crop, re-size and apply a variety of Aviary filters to uploaded images and easily post them in your Facebook photo albums.
With InstaShirt you can have your Instagram photos printed on a shirt quickly and easily. Choose from multiple shirt designs and customized text. Add multiple photos to one design.
Free HTML5 slideshows from Facebook, Flickr, Photobucket, Smugmug, Picasa, Youtube (as soundtrack music) and SlideshowBox HTML5 slideshow component.

Printsgram provides printable PDF files from your Instagram photos, with several different layout templates. PDF files are created on standart international paper sizes, so you can print them with your printer or go to a local print store for larger prints.
bookfriend is an Android application which creates companion guides for any book instantly and seamlessly wherever you are.
Capture your memories from popular social media sites. See, search and share your photos, music, video, status updates, blog posts and more.

Display your Etsy profile, shop or listings in a signature banner image which you can use in forums, emails, websites, blogs, etc.. This dynamic signature will update automatically if you change your profile, shop info or if you add new items to your shop.
What do you get when you mix pictures from Flickr or Facebook with Chinese fortune cookies in MyChineseFortune.com? You get iPicFortune. It's a whole new way to view pictures and fortune cookies.
Gramfeed is an Instagram web client.

The premise of this MashApp is simple: Use Yahoo Query Language to access Flickr's RSS feed of current images, and then display them fashionably, using jQuery. 20 newly uploaded Flickr photos are selected at a time and displayed as thumbnails. Clicking any thumbnail opens the related Flickr photoset. The process repeats every few seconds and can be paused by pressing the space bar. The time between sets and the drop down speed are configurable.
Watch the internet as it's being uploaded. Every 10 seconds it grabs the newest public photo from Flickr.
A website about holidays and ayurveda treatments in Kerala. With maps, flickr images and easy booking of your vacation.
Search for anything instantly. Find tweets, news, videos and products, with results updated instantly.
See the weekly top 20 users from Flickr, as well as a selection of their highest-rated photos. Also options to see most favorites photos, most commented photos and most-used cameras.
Jigsaw is a puzzle game automatically generated from the most interesting Flickr photos of the day.

Kukunu is a new travel planning experience that simplifies the life of travellers around the world. Travelers can collaborate to create their itinerary then add transports, hotels, restaurants, activities and sights across the cities they plan to visit.
FlickrQ allows you to queue up and schedule your uploads to Flickr. It is quick, simple and free.
Get Gulf oil spill updates and oil spill clean up news, see oil spill photos, watch oil spill videos, chat about oil spills and more at Oilaholic.com.
A plugin for Apple's iPhoto application to export photos to expono.com.

A social network to share photos. It collects automatically all your photos and contacts from Facebook, Flickr and Picasa and allows you to share your photos with your friends whatever their website is.

A photo atlas of New York City created by a fusion of semantic web data, flickr photos, and crowdsourcing. Based on semantic GIS technology that can assign accurate geotags based on textual and other metdata.

With Geoslideshow you can create trails of your travels using Google Maps and Flickr photos. Several Geoslideshows can be created: Static: a map with static photos, Dynamic: a map with more interactivity trough a slideshow, Google Maps, KML.
The portfolio site of Ideum, an exhibit and Web design firm that specializes in multitouch and social media. Using WordPress and Flash.
Allows Box.net users to send files from their Box accounts to Snipshot to be edited, then save them directly back to Box from within Snipshot.
Simple and intuitive search tool, allows displaying photo time and date taken in either a radial or standard X,Y axis plot.
Breakfasts, lunches and dinners from Twitter.
An open source free Java Point of Sale system for restaurants. To ensure fast development and scalability, Floreant POS used the Flickr API and Google Custom Search engine.
French automobile site which integrates Google Maps.
See live photo uploads on FLickr.com as they happen.
TwitShop uses the real-time power of Twitter to search for personal sale, trade and auction items.
StumblePics allows you to discover new pictures by stumbling upon them.
A photo manipulation site. A mashup with Touchnote that allows you to send postcards from the site.
An online diary for Twitter users. It's totally free. Track and rate your Moo'd Tweets...

iMapflickr.com allows non-techie users to create fully customizable embeddable google maps of geocoded flickr photosets or search results. You can use it to create maps of your own photos, or other users.

Easily add relevant photos to your blog posts without leaving Wordpress. Turn on the affiliate option to start earning money from links on your photos. Simple, automatic and lucrative photos for Wordpress blogs.
MAPyou is a mashup for location-based services. With Sony-Ericsson phones you can use the MAPyou app.
Stay connected with your friends and contacts in your social networks, wherever you are. Vodafone Update provides mobile access to Twitter, Facebook and MySpace, combined in a single UI.
Stay connected with your friends and contacts in your social networks on the go. Vodafone Update provides mobile access to Twitter, Facebook and MySpace, combined in a single UI.

Having a creative mental block? Don't worry, you've come to the right place. SparkStorm is an online tool based on two very common methods used to energize brainstorms: Random Word and Random Picture.
Local news for Northumberland County, Ontario, Canada. Integrates local news sources with Flickr and Twitter activity in the area.
Human Pets is a social site where veryone on Human Pets is an animal. You can be fed, combed, pet, taken on trips, nicknamed, and others.

Worldsaurus.com is a worldwide travel guide to help adventurous budget-travelers, backpackers, photographers, and vacationers plan their trips. Find the most popular places in the world, with detailed information.
GeoImpress provides a completely new way to search for places all over the world. Integrates Google Maps, Flickr, and Twitter.

A trending tag visualization for Twitter and Flickr. Try out any tag you like by appending ?t=[twitter-tag]&f=[flickr-tag] to http://r8ar.com. You may have seen this on the big screen at a Yahoo! Hack Day.
A local restaurant guide providing restaurant ratings, restaurant reviews, restaurant coupons, maps and a huge directory.
Mashup screensaver shows the latest New York Times online news illustrated with current relevant crowd-sourced Flickr photos in real-time. And most times it is quite badass photo editor.

A customizable mashup for others to extend. Each consumer of the wizard can supply a Flickr username and-or a Flickr tag that will be used to create a Flickr widget that streams photographs from Flickr.
Demo service from Pho.to for creating animated gif avatars or static avatars for free. You can adopt the same functionality on your site using the pho.to API.
A way to explore all life forms in a taxonomic way. Useful for students, scientists and curious people. Flickr and GBIF (gbif.org) APIs.
A free site-building service that takes data from APIs and other content sources as a way for niche publishers to quickly create content-rich sites along with built-in monetization options.

Locago is a mobile framework with an open API for third party content. GPS enable, turn-by-turn navigation, global map coverage and supported by 105+ different phone models. 45+ different content layers available in Locago.
A real-time list of the most recent tweets and Flickr photos concerning beds and bedrooms. More feeds to come.
A smart way to browse and locate Flickr images on a large map of the world. Cruise Flickr photos, tags and people based on geotagged location. Combines the power of Google maps along with Flickr.
An interactive African tourist guide providing rich interactive content. Built using Microsoft Silverlight along with Google Maps.
Get maps and information about your favorite stars, plus view maps. Get star, planetarium, and observatory information.
Free online service for creating funny pics from your photos. Makes a photo mashup in one click. Many templates. Uses an advanced face detection mechanism, based on the pho.to Enhancement Platform.
Ever wondered where all your Flickr photos were, or how many places have photos tagged Paris? This app should answer all your questions.

A unique and scalable process was used to identify and find photographs of more than 1500 automobile models. Images are free to use under CC-BY or CC-BY-SA licenses. This site exports Linked Data using RDF-XML and the SIOC ontology.
Twitter realtime feed. iGoogle style drag and drop with Twitter power search. Search current daily and weekly trends. Search TwitPics and audio.
A showcase of the best travel attractions around the world with videos, maps, descriptions, recent blog posts and pictures for almost every attraction.
Browse through birds of the world, categorized by continent and country. When you click a bird link, photos are retrieved from Flickr, and Wikipedia integration appears.

Infinite Monkey Comics presents a random image from Flickr superimposed with some text off of Twitter, based on keywords of your choosing. Think of it like the Infinite Monkey Theorem, but instead of Shakespeare the monkeys are creating comics.
Aggregate news from all around the web, provide related stories, wikinews, tags, wikipedia links, flickr photos , tweets and more...
An easy way to upload your TwitPic images to Flickr. Uses APIs from Flickr, TwitPic and Twitter.
Bookmarklet to find Flickr photos taken nearby in time and space to any geotagged Flickr photo.
Twyric is the art of mashing up Twitter poems with Flickr images for contemplation. Twyric = Twitter + lyric.
An easy interface to search for Flickr images. Includes advanced options to search by license type or date posted.
Flickr application for Microsoft Windows Mobile.
Watch Flickr photos on a virtual pinboard in your Web browser. You can zoom and arrange them with your mouse or play a quick puzzle.

Photo sharing an enormous 2-d surface. GoogleMaps-style navigation. Place, arrange, rotate, re-size images to form photo collages. Edit images in real-time with friends. Share to Facebook, Myspace, and other services.

View satellite imagery at full screen, dynamic update to the URL for every move of the view. Bookmark current view and come back later, or shows your friends for a particular location. Lets you populate articles and photos to current view.

View Flickr photos Photo Album style. Photo details include description, tags, and comments. Use the arrow keys to flip through photos and spacebar to zoom in-out. Also includes slideshow playback and Search by Tag via Photo and Album tag clouds.
COOLIRIS + Flickr = The best way to search for images online. Formerly called CoolFlick

Browse through all the mountains of the world categorized by continent, country. The mountain coordinates are mapped in Google maps, along with photos got from flickr. Provision is given to visit the details about the mountain in Wikipedia from the Map
Travel planning site for independent travelers integrating Google Maps, Flickr, and various social networks for photo albums, trip planning, blogging and guide browsing.
Displays information on different types of aircraft including manufacturer, date of the first flight and other information. Uses Flickr API to search and display aircraft photos.
Get random images from a Flickr group of your choosing. Good for use in other mashups, websites or just for browsing. Mashup using Google App Engine and Flickr.
Mashup to easily share your Flickr photos on Twitter.

Search and view Flickr photoset slideshows in cool 3D layouts: Cover Flow, Carousel, Grid, Spiral, Roller Coaster, and Time Machine. Powered by OpenFlux 3D, aka PlexiGlass. Includes large photo view, full screen mode, thumbnail strip and photo shuffling.
Track your own and your friends travels
Uses PHP and xslt to transform RSS feeds from Flickr into thumbnailed HTML pages. See demo and download code to run it on your own site.
Moomazon lets you create business cards for a book, using details from Amazon.com.

Ten Word Moo Card takes the best rated reviews from The Ten Word Review, a site where you can review anything you like as long as you do it in exactly ten words, and creates Moo cards from them. Winner of the Moo API contest 2008.
New year's greetings using the Flickr API.
A personalized information portal from Mauritius Island which integrates Flickr and del.icio.us.
Sad tweets are grabbed from Twitter and illustrated via pictures from Flickr. Sometimes the pictures and the text are not a perfect match. Other times the matches seem profound.

SakMap is the Swiss army knife of Maps. It has a built in local services search with data available for each US city the ArcGIS geocoder identifies such as weather, photos, videos, imaging, news, wikipedia and more.
This experiment is about relating flickr.com or del.icio.us user to each other based on usage of similar tags.
Second thought is a dynamic image and text composition. You can choose any words to change the picture or the word. Uses APIs from Flickr, Summize and Twitter.
A mashup of Napa Valley wineries using Google Maps and Flickr.
A photo puzzle game that integrates photos from Flickr. This game was built using the sharendipity platform.
A mashup for rating photos on Flickr.

An application that uses Flash to explore Flickr photos via virtual 3D planetary systems. Enter a tag, and the related galaxy appears on screen. When you click on a sun, the images are placed on a 3D rotating globe.
Snaplickr is a Flickr photos search tool and social utility. Users can bookmark favorite photos and leave comments for others. Rich Flash based UI.
Explore Bournemouth UK on a Virtual Earth Map with birds eye views and panoramic photos.
Simple new interface for Flickr albums with a Blogger blog.
Mashup that uses the new Flickr API video features to let you browse the newest videos on Flickr.
Use TiVo to display your Photobucket photos on your home television.
Create an advanced photo calendar with your Flickr photos. It is easy to use, and there are many templates to choose from.
A simple mashup showing interesting Flickr photos.

A GPS-based social network that allows people to share geolocation data using a small application installed in their mobile devices. Follow in Google Earth real-time, send photos to Flickr, map to blogs, and more.
A mashup of Google Maps and Flickr's hosted videos.
A large and growing collection of Creative Commons animal photographs selected from Flickr.
FlickTickr allows you to create your own scrolling ticker for your favorite Flickr feeds. It takes only two steps to create a ticker.
Combines Flickr, Last.fm and YouTube. Create your own folders, drag your videos, and view videos in a player.
A map of nuclear-weapons-related sites in the United States. Features photos from Flickr.
A site to browse pictures from Rio de Janeiro, Buzios, Ceará, and other places in Brazil. Uses the Google Picasa API.
Browse photos by Arab country name.
Wrapr is a mashup between Chumakev Flash panorama player and the Flickr API. Flickr panoramic images can be wrapped into an interactive panorama. Browse for Flickr groups, and Wrapr them.
Montreal public transit planner helps you find your way around Montreal. Specify your origin, destination, and options related to your trip. Stop photos are dynamically retrieved from Flickr.
Allows users to add RSS feeds, applications, email and web sites to their personal Ticker. NetTickr is always scanning the users net for new items and displays the content in the users NetTickr.
Presenting vintage photos from Flickr in an interesting way.
Create a slideshow with voice narration of your Flickr photos.

jiffr is a picture based dating service that works without words. You introduce yourself without words, only using the language of your flickr pictures and so you get a date without words. This is a free service.
Google Picasa image search, in Turkish language. Uses GoogleAjaxFeeds to show latest searches.
Photoree aims to be to photos what Last.fm is to music and StumbleUpon to websites. It adapts to your preferences and taste, recommending to you the best images that may interest you.
Share photos on Twitter with TwitPic.
A slideshow of photos from Flickr. Show your photos or photos matching certain tags. Highly customizable with ability to change many display options. Uses Flickr and Widgetbox APIs.
A fun way to explore Flickr images based on your own taste. Select a couple of images you like and instantly get recommendations, based on like-minded people.
Add photos search from Flickr photos in your website and display them.
The FlickrSpy is back. Check out the new 2008 FlickrSpy and watch whats uploaded right now at flickr.
FlickrEdit is a Java Desktop application for displaying and editing your photos in a variety of ways. It also allows you to download or upload your photos to and from Flickr.
Compare the image results for two competing keywords.
A Java-based Flickr backup utility that lets you back up all your photos on Flickr.
A large collection of placemarks from all around the world. See multiple satellite views, birds eye view, Google Earth and photo galleries. Get directions to popular locations.
Phreetings, photo + greetings, is a service for creating photo greeting cards using a drag-and-drop technique. The photos that you drag are Flickr images.
Find interesting facts in a fun way on all the countries of the world.
GeoTag Flickr-Photos via GPS track file. Start tracking-mode on your gps-device, go on a phototour, share your photos by flickr and Geotag them.

For each of the 1.95 million DBpedia concepts, the wrappr generates a collection of flickr photos that depict the concept, utilizing multilingual labels and geo-coordinates provided in Wikipedia entries.
View galleries of black-and-white images. You can view the images with your own tags, or browse the latest or most popular tags.
Watch new photos being uploaded to Flickr in real time. Uses Ajax.
Search Flickr by tags.
to.uri.st is a geocoded database of tourist attractions the World over. We have a RESTful API to allow reading and updating of our copyleft data.
Flickr Tool developed using Flickr and YahooMap REST APIs. This is an Adobe AIR version of MyFlickrTool.
IbizaA-Z.com and Ibiza Now Magazine. Everything from one Google Map.
Flash application developed using Flickr and Yahoo Map APIs.

Mobypicture enables you to add postings with pictures to Twitter and also get these directly posted to your Flickr-album. You can use it from your mail client or directly from your phone, so you can show your friends what your doing instead of typing it.
Ransomizr creates a randomly generated font from single-letter Flickr images and allows you to immediately compose and save ransom-letter-style notes.
Allows you to create mosaics of photos from Flickr. Each mosaic is one large image composed of small tile images.
Uses Flickr API to do fun stuff with photos. Home of the fd Flickr Toys.

Mashup of Google Maps, Virtual Earth with many other APIs. Ext.js is used to make user interface intuitive. It lets you search for hotels, photos, restaurants, wifi spots, local news/blogs, events, weather, and many other spatial data.

searchCrystal lets you search and visually compare multiple engines in one place. It is a search visualization tool for remixing and sharing results from the best web, image, video, blog, tagging, news engines as well as Flickr images or RSS feeds.

Consolidation of information about notable people, including celebrities, musicians, writers, historical figures and sports people. Auto-ranking of people based on density of current news and automatic analysis of connections between people.
At GPSies.com, you can view and download tracks that have been recorded by a GPS device. Search for running, hiking, and biking routes. You can download all of the tracks.
Watch the data that you care about in this screensaver mashup of Facebook, Flickr, Twitter, and blogs. This visualization lets you configure what you want to watch and the speed in which you see it.

Create a scrapbook, family album, or other physical book using this web-based creation tool. Lets you integrate photos from Flickr. Click Start Book and then the Demo MemoryPress link to view a video that shows the mashup of Flickr and a user book.
Provides a list of videos, pictures, maps, and wikipedia information for Forbes traveler's list of top 50 locations.
Generative fictives biographies. Search picture memories in Flickr.
Search and compare Nikon DSLR photos.

Upload your Dive profiles from any Suunto dive computer or bottom timer. Reports generated automatically with depth-time profile chart, vertical speed chart etc. Attach GPX track logs from your GPS. Attach photos from Flickr or videos from Youtube.
Streeartmap supports buskers works and gives visitors the possibility to vote every single performance, like digg.

map.movin360 shows a trip through the city of Berlin. The panoramic movie is synchronized to GoogleMaps. During the virtual tour, you can move the camera around. Get further information and view related photos.
A simple site that uses the Flickr API to download pictures for an entered user and view them on a larger scale.

Browse through list of all the rivers of the world categorized by continent, country. The rivers coordinates are mapped in Google maps, along with photos got from flickr. Provision is given to visit the details about the river in Wikipedia from the Map.
Online travel blog with Flickr photo integration.
Music videos search from YouTube.
Create a photomosaic out of thousands of flickr images.
ShutterPoint Image Upload API Demo mashup is based on their API and shows a sample HTML form to interact with the API.
Statr for Flickr allows you to track and plot page views statistics for your Flickr account. Graphs are automatically updated on a daily basis and can be linked from external websites.
Social networking travel websites that creates personalized recommendations for each user based on user interests and user ratings. Uses geotagged Flickr photo stream and Google maps.
psynchr is a Flash based web service to view multiple photosets. You can synchronize multiple photosets on flickr.
Helps image buyers more efficiently find images and image owners to sell them, by accepting payments for them and archiving licenses for public inspection.
Allows users of flickr and 23 photo services to mash up their images into an interactive web page with the option of including Google Maps or Second Life Maps as a background.

The MyDataBus service provides a simple way to store, transfer, and share your files online. Data can include photos, videos, and others. Integrates with social tools like Facebook. Integration with Snipshot allows online photo editing.
Bookr is a tool to create photobooks using Flickr images. Photobooks may be e-mailed or embedded in blogs.
Real-time visualizations of the stream of information flowing into Flickr. View photos, tags or buddy icons as they are active on the site.
Memory game that chooses Flickr pictures as cards, based on a tag you enter.

Phrasr is an interactive web based application that uses Flickr images to illustrate the phrases that users submit. You can choose every image and then publish the entire phrase, which is shown as a personal slide show.
Look for public Flickr photos with this tag-based search.
Helps children learn the English alphabet through photos.
Create sets of media related to fashion, particularly leaning towards coverage of fashion events, and share them with other members.

A generative artwork that explores how advertising uses and manipulates language. Real corporate slogans are remixed and randomized to generate invented slogans, then paired with Flickr images, generating fake advertisements on the fly.
Compare two images and pick the winner in this HotOrNot-style voting mashup. See pairs of photos of men, women, cars, cats, dogs and more. Note: some photos not safe for work, NSFW.
Generative fiction with Google Maps and Flickr.
Search any location in the world and find photos, videos, docs, map, satellite imagery and nearby places related to it.
Search Photos from over 2,000,000 snaparazzi. Buy and sell photos. Using the Fotolia API.
See what gets uploaded to flickr.com right now.
A mashup of Google Maps and Flickr. Double click on a country marker to see popular Flickr photos using a simple Ajax interface. Also includes quick links to Wikipedia entries for each country.
Community networking site that allows members to get in touch with their neighbours. The site uses APIs from Nestoria, flickr, Eventful and more to provide local information to users.
SummerOf.com gives you photos from typical holiday locations. But the twist is that you can select which summer you want to see pictures from, like Paris 2004.
Slideshow of most interesting and recent photos from flickr using the Lightbox Ajax tools.

ZoobTube is a mashup that grabs the artist and title of the most most recent song played on Radio Paradise and then uses those as keywords to search both Flickr and You Tube for photo and video content.

The American Image: Photographs of John Collier Jr. is an online exhibit exploring the work of John Collier during the war years of the 1940s. Flickr mashups are used to pull in photographs making up the Collection and one of the interactive activities.

Download and install this map on your own site. Double-click anywhere on the map for details on that location. Geowalk light is made with Flash. So it is easy to install on other websites. A English, French, Spain, Polish and German Version.
Image search in the 2 million royalty free images in photo bank Fotolia. Also use it to create instant e-cards.
Comic strip related art in Brussels, Belgium. Includes Tin Tin.

Very nicely done interactive map of current world and local news mapped. Double-click on the green markers for more levels of detail. Comprehensive listings, good responsiveness. Data drawn from global and local sources via Topix.net.
This shows photos of Flickr in Google Maps API Interface, not on map. You can search by tag, text and username.
A sufer blog that hosts a surf spot locator that uses Google Maps and Flickr API.

A promo site for Penguin books, tracking the tour of a woolly mammoth across the UK. Vistors are invited to share their photos of the mammoth via Flickr, and post opinions. Photos are referenced by city, opinions by postcode and presented via GoogleMaps.
Combines YouTube videos, Flickr photos, Last.fm albums and Amazon books, grouped by Wikipedia category.
Hangman game for Flickr tags. Guess all the letters of a tag and see 4 photos.

This web application called the StainedGlass Collage, first detect region of interest in your digital photo and then organize them similar to laying out a stained glass window. It also allow user to download and upload images directly to Flickr site.
Creative on-demand print service that lets you turn your Flickr photos from virtual content into physical content like all new Mini Cards.
Flash-based interface for searching for Flickr photos and YouTube videos by tag. Initially created by Ted Patrick for an Adobe Flex demo at Mashup University.
A tag-based search engine that combines results from Flickr, delicious, Technorati and Google News.
A dynamic network feed of geo-tagged Flickr photos in Google Earth.
Find mashed up maps in your locale: city, state, country, or the world, sorted by categories. Updated daily with your suggestions.
loc.alize.us displays a massive amount of photos on a highly interactive world map. Explore photos from everyones places, selected topics or people you know.
A collection of stuff to do with Flickr image manipulation, community based photo search engine and a system to print photos on shirts, mugs, and stickers.

A better search for Flickr. Uses special processing to find for more than just what you search for. Searching for music will not just look for that word but also for concert, band, ipod and other related concepts.
Clockr uses random digit images from Flickr to display the current time. Click on a number to change the image, doubleclick it to view the full image. Use the mouse wheel to cycle through.

Frame an ecard using this web tool using photos from your own computer, from a remote site using a web address or from your Flickr account. Then send it via email as an ecard or save it to your Flickr account.
Modeled off the classic educational number-munching game. Munch photos from the flickr database tagged with a particular word, and simultaneously contribute to a visual ranking system.
See what color is currently the favorite one for photos on Flickr. Histogram of color bars at top of page are based on the current sampling.
Choose from over 20 creative styles for presenting your Flickr photos. Interesting variety. Creates clean urls for bookmarking and sharing.
Small flash app lets users write short stories, get auto-generated illustrations from Flickr photos, and play around with the results. Nicely done.
A useful worldwide travel guide in German and English. With embedded data from Wikipedia, Flickr and Google News. Double-click anywhere on the map for details on that location.

A home in SL that sports a simple picture frame. Touch it and it looks up your avatar name to see what your favourite Flickr tag is, picks a random picture with that tag from Flickr and displays it on its surface.
ScreenSvr is a simple screen saver for Windows PCs. It grabs photos from Flickr, based on your selection criteria, and displays them in a repeating slideshow as a screensaver.
Travel Information Directory. Mashup of Naver and Flickr.
Flickrball is a fun six-degrees-of-separation scavenger-hunt game, using Flickr thumbnails and tags for clues.
mashfot is a one-page view about photography. You can find links, news and photos on this site.
Subscribe to a Flickr page, getting email notifications whenever you upload new photos.
Explore the relationship between Flickr groups and photos with this useful groups browser.
Multiple ways to browse random images from Flickr: all, interestingness, photostreams, groups, etc.
Mashup of a popular online sudoku player and Flickr. Sudoku player courtesy sudoku.com.au.
Online image editor with basic editing features and Flickr integration.
Fun flickr mashup that lets you add cartoon bubbles to photos.
Fun way to turn Creative Commons licensed pictures from Flickr into digital postcards.
Adictive photo puzzle game. Match two pictures that have something in common in the picture. Your goal is to match the photos that have these tags in common. Harder than it seems.
Create photo slideshows with music. Site allows you to add Flash to flickr, myspace, xanga, and Blogger
Content based visual image search application for Flickr. Look for an image you like, then Find Similar photos either by subject matter mode or color and texture mode.
An online image editor that integrates nicely with Flickr.
Use this handy Jacktracker mashup to follow the TV show 24. Incorporates images and various plot details. Uses the Wayfaring.com features such as discussion boards for each waypoint.
Use this album maker to build an album and a slideshow of your Flickr photos. It can generate HTML code for you to embed to your blog or web site.
A lightweight Flickr viewer. You can search and browse photos by users, contacts, photosets, tags, or groups. If the photo is geotagged, it can also be mapped.
Innovative prototype for exploring Flickr photos. Point the application at a feed, like CNN, it then renders the news in photos by matching tagged photos to words from the news.
Desktop application for managing photos on the Smugmug service.
A very fun Flickr game in which you view a set of ten images and try to guess the common tag. Time based scoring.
A visually rich interactive Flash tool for exploring place based on the geotagged photos at Flickr. Search by user, tag and collection.
An nice explorative Flash-based interface into Flickr photos. With tag search, interestingness sorting, user tabs, and related tags.
Search Flickr for geotagged photos and then plot them on a Google Map. Nice nested map-within-a-map.
Experimental navigation tool for exploring the space of related Flickr tags. Type in one start tag and dive into tag space. Requires Flash 8.
Nice search and visualization tool that lets you surf Flickr's tag space. Flickr tags are keywords used to classify images. Related tags shown based on clustered usage analysis.
smugmug photos overlaid on top of Google Maps.
Automated photo mosaics using Flickr

Mashup of Amazon (for album/book details), Audioscrobbler (for related artists), Flickr (for tagged photos), del.icio.us (for tagged links), Blogdigger (for media files) and Feedster (for matching weblog posts).
Display flickr photos for your Tivo
Flickr screensaver for Windows XP
